mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate is below 4.0%.
failure_condition: Average 20d return when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in t-test against zero.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 5d return when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months is not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20d return when both HOUST and RSAFS decline is not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline exceeding 1.0% (INDPRO) signals manufacturing supply shock that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60d return when INDPRO declines > 1.0% in a month is not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly non-farm payroll increase exceeding 100k (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20d return when PAYEMS increases > 100k is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly consumer price index above 2.5% annualized (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure that triggers Federal Reserve monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20d return when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (annualized) is not negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic expansion (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), sustained corporate earnings growth drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60d return when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% is not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline and unemployment rate rise (FEDFUNDS down, UNRATE up) signal severe economic downturn, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20d return when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises is not negative (p > 0.05).
